auction.venue: In front of the Paulding County Courthouse
auction.time: First Tuesday of the month, beginning at approximately 11:00 am
auction.payment: Cash or certified funds made payable to the Paulding County Tax Commissioner.
auction.office: Paulding County Tax Commissioner, Property Tax Office
vital: The winning bidder receives a tax deed in exchange for payment.
The owner may redeem by repaying the full auction price plus 20% for the first year and 10% for each later year.
Redemption is a right for 12 months and stays open until the buyer sends a statutory barment notice (O.C.G.A. 48-4-40 and following).
The parcel list for each sale is posted under Tax Sale Accounts on paulding.gov.
Parcels that drew no bid are kept on a Previously Advertised Parcel List and can be re-advertised on request to the Tax Commissioner.
auction.next_dates: October 2026 tax sale (parcel list posted; sales are held on the first Tuesday)
